items.question: Какая общая выручка по каждой категории товаров за всё время?
items.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (
    1 - oi.discount / 100
  )) AS total_revenue
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.id = oi.order_id
INNER JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.id
INNER JOIN categories AS c
  ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE
  o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
  c.name
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100
items.answer: Общая выручка по категориям товаров за всё время: лидером является категория 'Ноутбуки' с выручкой 1 246 266 391 руб., что составляет 34% от общей выручки. Второе место занимает 'Серверное оборудование' с 813 061 385 руб. (22% от общей выручки). Тройку лидеров замыкает категория 'Смартфоны' с 509 641 787 руб. (14% от общей выручки).

items.question: Выведи выручку за первый и за второй квартал 2026 года двумя отдельными числами.

        1 - order_items.discount / 100

    AND orders.created_at >= '2026-04-01'

)
SELECT

    FROM second_quarter

items.question: Какая категория товаров имеет самую высокую валовую маржинальность?
items.reason: no predicted column matches gold column(s): name
items.sql:
WITH completed_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.id,
    o.created_at,
    oi.product_id,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price,
    oi.discount,
    p.cost,
    c.name AS category_name
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
  INNER JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
  INNER JOIN categories AS c
    ON p.category_id = c.id
  WHERE
    o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  category_name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
    1 - oi.discount / 100
  ) - p.cost * oi.quantity) AS gross_margin
FROM completed_orders AS oi
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY
  category_name
ORDER BY
  gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 1

items.question: Какой средний чек выполненного заказа?
items.sql:
WITH completed_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.id,
    SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (
      1 - oi.discount / 100
    )) AS order_revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY
    o.id
)
SELECT
  NULLIF(SUM(order_revenue), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS average_check
FROM completed_orders
JOIN orders AS o

items.question: Какой процент всей выручки приходится на три самые прибыльные по выручке категории вместе?
items.sql:
WITH total_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.name AS category,
    SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (
      1 - oi.discount / 100
    )) AS revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
  JOIN categories AS c
    ON p.category_id = c.id
  WHERE
    o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY
    c.name
  ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
  LIMIT 3
), total_revenue_all AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(revenue) AS total
  FROM total_revenue
)
SELECT
  tr.category,
  (
    tr.revenue * 100.0 / NULLIF(trr.total, 0)
  ) AS revenue_percentage
FROM total_revenue AS tr, total_revenue_all AS trr
LIMIT 100
